title: Space Marine (Warhammer 40,000) — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The selfish-gene reading of Space Marine (Warhammer 40,000) makes it less romantic and far more precise. In the fictional universe of Warhammer 40,000, the Space Marines, also known as the Adeptus Astartes, are superhuman warrior-monks who fight for the Imperium of Man. They wear mechanised suits of armour and have modified genomes that grant them superhuman strength and endurance.

The psychology underneath Space Marine (Warhammer 40,000) is simpler and older than the story on top. A Space Marine's commitment to his Chapter is lifelong and they rarely have any kind of personal life outside the Chapter (with the exception of the Salamanders chapter). Space Marines are conditioned to have a fanatical reverence for the Emperor of Mankind.
